Ten searches were run against FamilySearch's historical record index for **Bartholomew Flynn** — across various surname spellings (Flynn, Flyn, Flinn, Fl\*n), given name forms (Bartholomew, Bartolomew, Bartley, Barth\*), and locations (United States and Ireland) — and **all ten returned zero results**.

1. **Formally plan searches for Bartholomew** via the research-plan agent — targeting Pennsylvania county records, Schuylkill County household census browsing, or Irish emigration records.
2. **Try external sites** (Ancestry, MyHeritage, etc.) through the search-external-sites agent.
3. **Browse unindexed image collections** (search-images agent) for Schuylkill County, PA records.

All ten searches have been logged to the project (log_005 through log_014).
